d:
Jharkhand ke Dumka men tuphan ke asar ke bich tej barish ne kisanon ki mushkilen barha di hain. barish ke karan kheton men khari phaslon ko bhari nuksan pahunchne ki khabar hai. kisanon ki mehnat par pani phirne se unki chinta barh gaee hai. dekhie Dumka se yah riporta.
About Channel:
ABP Bihar pradesh ki khabron ka ek aisa chainal hai jahan pradesh se juri har khabar aapke pas sabse pahle pahunchti hai. bihar ki rajniti, bihar ki barh, lalu - nitish ka ek dusre par palatvar, apradh ki andruni khabar aapke pas tathyon ke sath lekar aata hai.
